
## owner-card-brief: a plain brief first on every queue card that needs the owner

- `local` (Ops #682; the owner via COO rm-d2c1f9b2, 2026-10-31 ~12:10 PDT: "whenever a card comes to me, I need to know the context in the simplest terms, ... i am just picking blind"; plan approved in Ops lead; project owner-cards-plain-context, step 1, whose pi-queue half is Ops #681). Hypothesis H-OWNER-CARD-BRIEF, HIT, with the lines, kinds, sources and surfaces in `docs/owner-card-brief.md`.
- `server/owner-card-brief.ts`: from records only, no model (rule 17), at most 600 characters of labelled plain lines (In short, The project, This task, Why you now, Waiting on it, Your answers, Recommended) with no ids, paths or rule numbers. The kind is the stuck op's saved `card` (pi-queue #681), else read from the queue's fixed question texts and package heads; an unknown card says "The task asks you a question."
- `server/asks.ts`: `Ask.brief`, `StuckAskInput.brief`, `AskHub.refreshBrief` (in place, no event). The brief is not in `stuckSig`, so a changed waiting count never makes a new card or resends Telegram. `server/agent-service.ts` only calls `stuckAskBriefs` in `reconcileStuckAsks` and copies the brief into `queueAnswerBindings`. `server/task-queue.ts` keeps `card`/`inShort` on a stuck task (mirror and canonical replay); `server/queue-blocks.ts` `knownQueues()`; `server/work-records.ts` `workProjectOf` (pi-queue's own `readWork`, read again only when the log changes).
- Shown first and whole: Telegram (`plugins/telegram/index.mjs` `renderBrief`, also in the short form; the package is still cut to 500 characters), the Roles page's decision cards (`web/src/roles-useful-model.ts` `briefLines`, `web/src/roles-exact/owner-asks.ts`, `web/src/roles-u0/surface.html`), the Roles answer dialog (`server/roles-asks.ts` `askViewOf`, outside the revision; `web/src/roles-answer-model.ts`; `RoleAnswerDialog`) and the Queue tab (`TaskQueuePanel`), the React ones through `web/src/components/OwnerCardBrief.tsx`. The browser's question dialog never shows queue cards, so it is unchanged.
- Checks: `tests/unit/owner-card-brief.test.ts` (the seven kinds, an unknown one, inference without `card`, waiters, the length squeeze, the three real cards: Temper #244 403 characters, Temper #243 399, Ops #666 323), `tests/unit/plugin-telegram.test.ts` (a 500+ character brief whole before the question, the package still cut), `tests/unit/roles-exact.test.ts` (between a card's header line and its question; none without a brief), and the asks, roles-answer, roles-answer-ui, roles-useful-asks, task-queue-panel, queue-blocks and work-records tests. On the old code the new module can't load and every surface test finds no brief.
- Undo: revert this commit and `pi-web-deploy` it. Nothing is stored; the queue's saved ops are untouched.
